g.text: Do PMM, weaker winds and reduced evaporation agree?
Red: positive PMM / wind anomaly opposing the mean flow / less latent heat loss; blue: opposite.
ERA5 wind + NCEP-NCAR R1 flux: ocean means over 10–30°N, 155–115°W, relative to 1991–2020.
Wind is a vector projection, not scalar wind speed. Different products; phase agreement does not establish WES causality.
2014 and 2015 are two development years of the same event: 8 events, 9 development years.
